messages:
noah: quick flag: found another parity mismatch between REST and the js sdk during a customer onboarding. REST accepts `max_output_tokens`, `stop_sequences`, and streams via SSE. js sdk uses `maxTokens`, `stop` and returns a single aggregated response for streaming endpoints. also the http client ignores `Retry-After` on 429s. putting repro here.

noah: repro curl (working as expected):
```
curl -s -N -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat/stream \
  -H \"Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN\" \
  -H \"Accept: text/event-stream\" \
  -d '{"model":"gpt-lite","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"ping"}],"max_output_tokens":50,"stop_sequences":["<END>"]}'
```

noah: curl streams SSE chunks and honors 429 Retry-After when throttled (server sends 429 + Retry-After: 12)

lena: :grimacing: i hit this in the quickstart too. our sample app's TS example uses the sdk helper `client.chat.stream()` and passes `stop_sequences`, which currently gets dropped. that explains the odd behavior in their test harness.

tom-sdk: thanks for the clear repro @noah. looks like the JS SDK mapping layer was written against an older api shape. i'm going to add aliasing for `max_output_tokens` -> `maxTokens` and `stop_sequences` -> `stop`. for streaming, i'll change the client to expose a rawSseMode flag so callers can opt into line-delimited SSE data (current helper aggregates). i'll also wire Retry-After into the retry middleware: if header exists and status==429, sleep exactly that many seconds before retry. fallback to exponential backoff if header missing.

noah: can you also make the streaming flag default to pass-through for v0.8.x clients? some customers rely on current aggregation behavior, but many prefer true streaming.

tom-sdk: good call. default will be backward compatible: keep aggregation behavior unless `rawSseMode:true` or SDK >=0.9.0 where we'll flip default. i'll open two PRs: one for alias + Retry-After (patch to release/0.8.x) and another for streaming API change targeted at main with a migration note.

lena: please also update the sample-app README and the quickstart snippets in docs so newcomers aren't confused by `temperature` defaults. CI caught a flake because our tests assumed temp=1.0 but sdk default is 0.7.

devx-bot: created ticket DEVEX-3344 linking PRs and the sample-app update. tagging @tom-sdk for follow-up.

ci-bot: preflight: unit tests 142 passed, integration (mock-server) 8 failed (2 related to streaming aggregation). marking release blocking until fixed.

noah: thanks all. customers onboarding on Dedicated saw strange behavior when embedding stop sequences into prompts. i'll circulate a short migration snippet in the customer channel and follow up if they need a hotfix.
